ucs.title: [LLM] Turla ComRAT non-browser process beaconing to Gmail web interface for C2
ucs.description: Hunts a non-browser binary establishing connections to Gmail / Google Mail web endpoints — the signature C2 channel of Turla's ComRAT v4 (Agent.BTZ lineage), which polls a hard-coded Gmail inbox via the web UI to fetch tasking and exfiltrate. Tied to Turla (Snake / Venomous Bear / Secret Blizzard / G0010) because abusing legitimate web mail as a covert bidirectional channel is one of their hallmark OPSEC moves.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest_host IN ("mail.google.com","www.googleapis.com") OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*.googlemail.com") AND All_Traffic.app="https" AND NOT All_Traffic.process_name IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","iexplore.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","msedgewebview2.exe","thunderbird.exe","outlook.exe") by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.dest_host All_Traffic.process_name 
| `drop_dm_object_name("All_Traffic")` 
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) 
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let browsers = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","iexplore.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","msedgewebview2.exe","thunderbird.exe","outlook.exe"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where RemoteUrl has_any ("mail.google.com","googlemail.com","www.googleapis.com")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (browsers)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), Connections=count(), Urls=make_set(RemoteUrl, 6)
          by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessAccountName
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where DstHostname has_any ("mail.google.com","googlemail.com")
| where isnotempty(HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent)
| where HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent !has "Mozilla" and HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent !has "Chrome" and HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent !has "Edg" and HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent !has "Safari" and HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent !has "Firefox"
| summarize FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), Hits=count(), Urls=make_set(Url, 6) by SrcIpAddr, SrcHostname, DstHostname, HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Non-Browser Process Connecting to Gmail Web Interface (Turla ComRAT C2)
id: 4b2c1d6e-9a3f-4c0b-8e21-7f5d3a1c2b90
status: experimental
description: Detects a non-browser process reaching Gmail / Google Mail web endpoints, consistent with Turla ComRAT v4 using a Gmail inbox as a covert C2 channel.
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Initiated: 'true'
    DestinationHostname|contains:
      - 'mail.google.com'
      - 'googlemail.com'
  filter_browsers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\iexplore.exe'
      - '\brave.exe'
      - '\opera.exe'
      - '\msedgewebview2.exe'
      - '\thunderbird.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter_browsers
falsepositives:
  - Mail-sync agents or backup utilities authorised to reach Google Mail
level: high
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1102.002
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.g0010
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @DestinationHostname:(mail.google.com OR *.googlemail.com OR www.googleapis.com) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\MsEdge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\Firefox.exe OR *\iexplore.exe OR *\IEXPLORE.EXE OR *\brave.exe OR *\opera.exe OR *\msedgewebview2.exe OR *\thunderbird.exe OR *\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(mail\.google\.com|googlemail\.com|googleapis\.com)/i
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/(chrome|msedge|firefox|iexplore|brave|opera|msedgewebview2|thunderbird|outlook)\.exe$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=count())
| count > 0
ucs.rationale: Generic web-service C2 detections flag everything; this one is anchored on the precise ComRAT v4 behaviour publicly documented by ESET — a standalone implant (not a browser) talking to the Gmail web front-end to read its task queue. ucs.title: [LLM] Turla PowerShell loader reflectively executing a registry-stored encrypted payload
ucs.description: Hunts PowerShell that reads a blob from the registry and reflectively loads/executes it in memory — the exact pattern of Turla's documented PowerShell loader (used to stage Kazuar, the RPC backdoor and ComRAT), which hides AES/3DES-encrypted payloads in HKCU/HKLM values and injects them fileless. Tied to Turla (Secret Blizzard / Waterbug / IRON HUNTER / G0010) because the registry-resident, in-memory-only loader is a defining piece of their fileless tradecraft.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") AND (Processes.process="*HKCU:*" OR Processes.process="*HKLM:*" OR Processes.process="*Registry::*" OR Processes.process="*Get-ItemProperty*" OR Processes.process="*gp *") AND (Processes.process="*FromBase64String*" OR Processes.process="*[Convert]::*" OR Processes.process="*Reflection.Assembly*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-Expression*" OR Processes.process="*IEX*" OR Processes.process="*VirtualAlloc*" OR Processes.process="*GetDelegateForFunctionPointer*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process 
| `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` 
| where NOT match(user, "\$$") 
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) 
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("HKCU:","HKLM:","Registry::","Get-ItemProperty","gp ")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("FromBase64String","[Convert]::","Reflection.Assembly","Invoke-Expression","IEX","VirtualAlloc","GetDelegateForFunctionPointer",".Invoke(")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ProcessCommandLine, FolderPath, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where TargetProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("HKCU:","HKLM:","Registry::","Get-ItemProperty","gp ")
| where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("FromBase64String","[Convert]::","Reflection.Assembly","Invoke-Expression","IEX","VirtualAlloc","GetDelegateForFunctionPointer",".Invoke(")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ParentProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: PowerShell Reflectively Loading Registry-Stored Encrypted Payload (Turla Loader)
id: 9d7e2a14-3b6c-4f81-bd09-1e5c8f2a4d77
status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell that reads a value from the registry and reflectively decodes/loads it in memory, matching Turla's registry-resident fileless PowerShell loader.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  selection_reg:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'HKCU:'
      - 'HKLM:'
      - 'Registry::'
      - 'Get-ItemProperty'
  selection_exec:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'Reflection.Assembly'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'VirtualAlloc'
      - 'GetDelegateForFunctionPointer'
  condition: selection_img and selection_reg and selection_exec
falsepositives:
  - Endpoint-management or software-deployment scripts that cache blobs in the registry
level: high
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1027
  - attack.t1112
  - attack.g0010
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE) (@CommandLine:(*HKCU\:* OR *HKLM\:* OR *Registry\:\:* OR *Get-ItemProperty*)) AND (@CommandLine:(*FromBase64String* OR *Reflection.Assembly* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *IEX* OR *VirtualAlloc* OR *GetDelegateForFunctionPointer*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| CommandLine=/(HKCU:|HKLM:|Registry::|Get-ItemProperty)/i
| CommandLine=/(FromBase64String|Reflection\.Assembly|Invoke-Expression|IEX|VirtualAlloc|GetDelegateForFunctionPointer)/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
| count > 0
ucs.rationale: A bare 'PowerShell + IEX' rule is pure noise; this requires the two-part combination Turla's loader exhibits — (a) pulling content out of a registry value and (b) reflectively decoding/injecting it in the same command — which is the documented mechanism Turla uses to keep Kazuar/Carbon/ComRAT stages off disk.
